requested_updates.comment: PR69 implements the first functional managed Codex backend-first path through the existing Core, Bridge, native TUI and DAG scheduler. The wider roadmap remains open.

Reuses provider-neutral Session/Core/Executor contracts, existing receipt/NoReplay policies, Code Intelligence and approved workers. No new scheduler or planning protocol. Continuation checks owned mapping/account epoch/history/digests.

Integrity-only natural text admission; simple queries and two related native TUI turns complete without DAG. Same-turn approved one-/two-worker changes pass real official Codex inference. Adaptive flag remains OFF; exact0.162.1 Linuxamd64 pair and same-process new-session rollout only.

Real A/B/C/D/E/F execution receipts include native TUI /exit and clean EOF shutdown, denied read + cancellation, duplicate409/no retry/failover, changed-path and fixed executable test oracles. All earlier failed epochs retained. Cross-process resume/other runtimes/real credential revocation not certified; final hosted CI required.
Official CLI-reported primary input/output/cache usage recorded. Worker usage unavailable, no billing/whole-session saving claim, no comparable Gateway OFF/ON cohort. Economic gate stays INCOMPLETE.
Existing scoped Code Intelligence Direct path and protected evidence controls reused; no redundant gateway/store or new automatic cache/prefetch. No claim of new Gateway coverage or cache savings.
